'''Saeric''' is a [[Red Water]] [[Goshien]] [[Aiel]].
 
== Appearance ==
He is a gray haired and has only one hand.

== Activities ==
He is seen in the [[Black Tower]] teaching the [[Asha'man]] how to fight barehanded.
